title: HighMemory alert on payments
query: HighMemory alert on payments, resident memory keeps climbing as traffic comes in.
root_cause: Payments keeps an in-memory cache that grows with every request and is never freed.

remediation.detail: Restart payments to reclaim memory, then bound the cache.

query_paraphrase: Got paged because payments is using more and more RAM, and it rises whenever requests come in.
